text:
Maddy Nguyen: Quick heads-up — opening a PR to add a migration example for Reserved Pools + an isolation annotation to the Dedicated docs. Needs small copy + code review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/423
Ben Cho: sending :eyes: can you include the SLA paragraph? folks have asked what happens on eviction.
Maddy Nguyen: yeah — thinking a short table row + a note: "eviction during maintenance = best-effort fallback to compatible model variants" — want to keep legal wording out of docs though.
Alex Perez: for code snippet, will we show Terraform + SDK example? I pushed a Terraform draft in the PR; snippet uses:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity_pool" "mypool" {
  reserved = true
  isolation = "tenant"
  autoscale {
    min_replicas = 2
    max_replicas = 10
    policy = "latency_slo"
  }
}
```
Ben Cho: small nit — use the resource name we committed last quarter (redwood_dedicated_capacity_pool), good catch on policy name.
Jason Li: can someone add a runnable SDK snippet for node/python for the autoscale policy so customers can copy-paste? People prefer that.
Maddy Nguyen: agreed. @Jason I'll add a minimal node example showing configureAutoscale({min:2,max:10,policy:'latency_slo'}) — will push later today.
docs-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-423--docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/ops/reserved_pools#migration (staging)
Marc O'Neill: Tested the Terraform example locally, found a missing provider block — adding:
```hcl
provider "redwood" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}
```
fixed it. I'll push that commit to the PR.
Alex Perez: Also add a short note about the isolation annotation name: use annotation `redwood.org/pool-isolation: tenant` (not `isolate: true`) — otherwise automation (controller) breaks.
Ben Cho: Can we add a callout about SLA tiers? e.g., "Dedicated SLA applies to pinned capacity; reserved pools can have best-effort eviction under maintenance windows. Check the SLA matrix." Link to SLA matrix in the PR.
Maddy Nguyen: added a one-line callout and linked the SLA matrix. Left TODO for legal to review. @Ben can you skim the wording?
Ben Cho: will do today. :thumbsup:
Jason Li: also added a Python SDK example for the is_isolated flag in the PR comments — suggest moving it into the main snippets section.
Maddy Nguyen: perfect — if no more blockers I'll merge after ben + docs review. Thanks everyone.
Ben Cho: no blockers from me after minor wording tweak.
docs-bot: PR merged by Maddy Nguyen — deploy started :rocket:
